args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like that it's clean and simple, and it's great that you include your contact email so people can easily reach you. If I could suggest one improvement, it would be to add a bit more content about yourself — for example, your background, interests, or projects you're working on. That would help visitors get to know you better and make the site more engaging. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around your favorite hobby, hiking — that's a wonderful theme that can really resonate with fellow outdoor enthusiasts! My suggestion would be to expand the site with more content, such as posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. Adding these details would make the blog more engaging and give readers a real sense of your hiking experiences. Happy trails!
